candidate_windows.window_text: We evaluate QRRETRIEVER on two tasks: longcontext reasoning (85.2) and re-ranking (85.3).

We use Llama-3.2 (3B), Llama-3.1 (8B and 70B）(Llama-3 Team，2024)， and Qwen2.5 (7B) (Yang et al., 2024). 8B models were run using a single NVIDIA A100 GPU with 80GB of memory, and 70B models were run using 4 A100 GPUs. All experiments were conducted on A1oo-based infrastructure.
